title: Are the recorded sounds clean enough to hold?

criteria.claim: Held sounds stay on pitch in the looped stretch.
criteria.source: Starting tolerance, set 2026-10-20; re-check against Brian's ear

criteria.claim: The two stretches a loop crossfades are alike, so the loop has no audible wobble.
criteria.source: -10 dB ≈ correlation 0.95 between the crossfaded stretches; starting tolerance, re-check by ear
